question:
The diagram given below has four different shapes, depicting different farmers of a small village, with different assets. The circle represents the farmers who own land of more than 100 yards, the pentagon represents farmers who own cows, the rhombus represents farmers who own goats, and the triangle represents farmers who own tractors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c41242d5d2af5dab2b8e7283416f610b21ce1ab9659c6d9d7e00cd262a7d0704.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab1621122ef1272f06611f4e2cbb83887669ba45631b39885759cf048def92c.png] 

How many farmers are there who have all four assets?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1896f2ca6f3c384fe9e53729166a72f3c9f5632113fc5d9f295b58865bc76114.png] 

Thus farmers are there who have all four assets =** 16**

Hence, the correct answer is** "16".**
